facts.fact: 苏齐发现朱迪思在贝思尼家全程一言不发，追问她是不是有什么事瞒着
facts.anchor: ‘No, I mean you, Judith,’ Suzie said. ‘You didn’t say a thing.’

facts.fact: 苏齐怀疑贝思尼把丈夫说成完美丈夫是撒谎
facts.anchor: ‘All that “my husband is perfect” malarkey? Show me a wife who thinks her husband’s perfect and I’ll show you a liar.

facts.fact: 苏齐当面提出贝思尼可能亲手射杀丈夫再伪造目击证词
facts.anchor: What’s stopping her from going into the woods with her husband, shooting him dead and then making up the story of seeing someone when the police arrived?

facts.fact: 自传作者哈里·阿斯奎特在屋外抽着烟等她们，开着一辆旧蓝色旅行车
facts.anchor: Harry Asquith was smoking a cigarette by an old blue estate car that was parked around the side of the house.

facts.fact: 哈里看出朱迪思真正想问的是他本人对加里的评价
facts.anchor: ‘Of course,’ Harry said as he realised what was behind the question. ‘You want to know what I thought of him.

facts.fact: 哈里说自己代写过许多自传，发现顶级运动员往往相似
facts.anchor: ‘Where to begin? Well, I suppose the point is, I’ve ghostwritten any number of autobiographies and top sports people are often very similar.

facts.fact: 加里十六岁时被利兹联青训放弃，这几乎击垮了他
facts.anchor: when he was sixteen, they let him go. Just like that. It nearly crushed him.

facts.fact: 加里在赛季最后一场比赛后与队友外出饮酒，违背了对贝思尼的承诺
facts.anchor: But the “last game of the season” bender is a strong tradition in football.

facts.fact: 加里前一天向哈里索要一名犯罪记者的联系方式
facts.anchor: Gary asked me yesterday if I had a contact in the press he could get in touch with.

facts.fact: 哈里把老同事、记者玛丽·珀特的电话号码给了加里
facts.anchor: I gave him the number of an old colleague of mine, a woman called Mary Pert.

facts.fact: 加里告诉哈里他生平唯一不能说的秘密，若贝思尼发现会杀了他
facts.anchor: there was only one thing in his life he couldn’t tell me about because he’d never told anyone. And if Bethany ever found out about it, she’d kill him.

facts.fact: 那个不能说的秘密发生在赛季最后一战后加里违背戒酒承诺外出饮酒时
facts.anchor: after the final match last season, he went out drinking with his teammates. Even though he’d promised Bethany he wouldn’t touch alcohol again.

facts.fact: 哈里描述加里说到那晚时的神情：像刚见过鬼一样
facts.anchor: ‘He looked haunted,’ Harry said. ‘Like he’d just seen a ghost.’
